question: By what means of origin is the fifth chapter identified as having come forth from Candradvīpa?
premises: This chapter is said to have emerged from Candradvīpa.
Its position in the sequence is the fifth.
It is designated as a paṭala within the text.
inference: The fifth chapter is the one that emerged from Candradvīpa.
uncertainties: The doctrinal significance of Candradvīpa as a source is not elaborated here.
plain_english: The fifth chapter is the one that emerged from Candradvīpa.
